learning_outcomes.text: Explain the time value of money and why it matters for investment decisions
Compute and interpret payback, NPV and IRR for a project
Identify relevant cash flows and exclude sunk and non-incremental costs
Choose and apply an appropriate hurdle rate
Compare and prioritise projects under capital constraints
Recognise the risks, biases and limits of appraisal numbers

integrative_case: A manufacturer with limited capital must choose among three equipment projects with different payback, NPV and risk profiles and justify the chosen portfolio to the finance committee. This is general business education, not investment advice.
